# Setup

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(terra)
library(here)

cleanup_sites <- read_csv(here("data", "theme6_plastic_waste.csv"))
cleanup_sites_sf <- st_as_sf(cleanup_sites, coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = 4326)
```

# Tasks

1. Generate a simulated 100x100 raster representing elevation (DEM) for the coastal zone.
2. Render the raster elevation model using `plot()`.
3. Extract pixel elevation values at each of our cleanup sites, appending them back to the stations table.

Write your raster calculation code below:

```{r}
# Generate DEM raster
dem_raster <- rast(
  nrows = 100, ncols = 100, 
  xmin = 39.2, xmax = 39.3, 
  ymin = -6.8, ymax = -6.7,
  crs = "EPSG:4326"
)
values(dem_raster) <- rep(seq(0, 300, length.out = 100), each = 100) + rnorm(10000, 0, 5)

# 1. Plot elevation
plot(dem_raster, main = "Coastal Digital Elevation Model (DEM)")

# 2. Extract values at cleanup coordinates
extracted_elevation <- terra::extract(dem_raster, cleanup_sites_sf)

# 3. Join back to original dataset
cleanup_sites_with_elevation <- cleanup_sites %>%
  mutate(elevation_m = extracted_elevation[, 2])

print(cleanup_sites_with_elevation)
```
